speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

zh: 而这一点的核心在于,你现在为帮助编码智能体而运行的同样的工作流——它们如今是相当复杂的流程,有 harness、评测、交接、子智能体、工具调用——你也要开始把其中一些最佳实践引入你的语音智能体。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: to an easily understandable set of semantic inventions.

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can start to see things like the session lifecycle, the audio input, the transcript, conversation items, the output, and then the response lifecycle and token counts as well.

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, yeah, real engineering work went behind this.

en: It's all open source.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: But tonality really matters.

speaker: Unknown
en: Positive, neutral, negative, not just a guess.

speaker: Unknown
en: Latency is really, really important in audio, and it's important in a few use cases.

speaker: Unknown
en: Models are getting better.

en: There's, you know, JEPA architectures, et cetera.

speaker: Unknown
en: But time to first audio SLAs are still really important for customer service use cases.
zh: 但首次音频时间 SLA 对客服用例来说仍然非常重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you want to be able to flag things that are breaking that.
zh: 你希望能够标记那些打破这一指标的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: You also want to flag things like I mentioned, like interruptions and accuracy, transcription drift, and the task success.
zh: 你还想标记我提到的东西，比如打断和准确性、转写漂移，以及任务成功率。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you want to be able to run these evals directly against the audio with evals that are based on audio models.
zh: 你希望能够直接针对音频运行这些评估，使用基于音频模型的评估。

speaker: Unknown
en: So LM as a judge evals on a transcript are only so good.
zh: 所以在转写文本上做 LLM 作为裁判的评估效果有限。

speaker: Unknown
en: But actually, evaling the underlying audio is really important.
zh: 但实际上对底层音频进行评估真的非常重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we have kind of the tooling available in Arise to be able to do that.
zh: 我们在 Arise 里有一些工具可以做这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're supporting all the major audio platforms as well as they come out with new models.
zh: 而且我们也在支持所有主要的音频平台，随着它们推出新模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: So again, evals specific to audio really matter.
zh: 所以再说一次，针对音频的评估真的很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're not just transcription-based evals.
zh: 它们不只是基于转写的评估。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as you start to scale up, your LM as a judge evals or even move to agent as a judge that are doing complex tasks like, for example, doing RBAC checks and making sure the agent actually accessed the system it was supposed to have access to.
zh: 而且随着你开始扩大规模，你的 LLM 作为裁判的评估，甚至转向智能体作为裁判来做复杂任务，例如，做 RBAC 检查并确保智能体实际访问的是它本应有权访问的系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: Being able to run these agent as a judge workflows in Arise starts to become really important.
zh: 能够在 Arise 里运行这些智能体作为裁判的工作流开始变得非常重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we're kind of seeing the industry move away from
zh: 而且我们有点看到行业正在从

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, just an LLM as a judge analyzing a transcript or even analyzing audio, but actually accessing tools, accessing third-party systems, and hydrating some of that evaluation information inside of it.
zh: 你知道，就是用一个 LLM 作为评判者来分析转写文本，甚至分析音频，但实际上是在访问工具、访问第三方系统，并在其中补充一些评估信息。

speaker: Unknown
en: So really easy to get started with evals in Arise through skills.
zh: 所以在 Arise 中通过 skills 上手评估非常容易。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is literally as simple as, hey Claude, create an audio eval for me for sentiment analysis using GPT audio, and catch frustrated user tone on those audio spans.
zh: 它真的简单到就是，嘿 Claude，帮我创建一个音频评估，用 GPT audio 做情感分析，在这些音频片段上捕捉用户沮丧的语气。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Arise will kind of take care of all the rest for you.
zh: 然后 Arise 会帮你处理好剩下的一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: The CLI under the hood is able to query spans, do some trace analysis, filter for the spans that are audio specific, actually create that eval, deploy it, and put it against traces and spans in your actual system.
zh: 底层的 CLI 能够查询片段、做一些追踪分析、筛选出音频相关的片段、实际创建那个评估、部署它，并把它应用到你真实系统中的追踪和片段上。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is part of why Arise exists.
zh: 而这也是 Arise 存在的一部分原因。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes, of course, you could do this yourself.
zh: 是的，当然，你可以自己做这些。

speaker: Unknown
en: But when you're trying to query billions of spans,
zh: 但当你试图查询数十亿个片段时，

speaker: Unknown
en: With sub-second query latency, it becomes really hard.
zh: 还要达到亚秒级的查询延迟，这就变得非常困难了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also deploying these live evals as they come in.
zh: 还有部署这些实时评估，随着数据进来的同时进行。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you're scoring them while users are actually interacting with your platform is really important.
zh: 所以在用户实际与你的平台交互时就对它们进行打分，这一点非常重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the final thing I'll mention is you also want these evals on the spans themselves, because then you start to be able to do really complex querying and filtering across your data.
zh: 然后我要提到的最后一点是，你还需要这些评估直接作用于片段本身，因为这样你就能够对你的数据做非常复杂的查询和筛选。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you're not just looking at a failure and looking up an external system.
zh: 这样你就不用只看着一个失败，然后去外部系统里查找。

speaker: Unknown
en: You actually have the eval scores in line with the exact audio that you're looking at.
zh: 你实际上把评估分数和正在查看的确切音频内联在了一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's why some of this is really powerful in Arise.
zh: 这就是为什么其中一些功能在 Arise 中非常强大。

speaker: Unknown
en: Being able to see those eval outputs directly on the spans that are relevant helps you kind of get a full understanding of what is going wrong with the user interaction.
zh: 能够直接在相关片段上看到那些评估输出，可以帮助你全面理解用户交互中出了什么问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then you can kick off workflows from that.
zh: 然后你可以从中启动工作流。

speaker: Unknown
en: So evals and monitors attached to those evals can kick off investigation agents that automatically start to dive into, you know, what tool calls am I misrepresenting?
zh: 所以评估以及挂载在这些评估上的监控器可以启动调查智能体，自动开始深入探究，你知道的，我在哪些工具调用上呈现得不对？

speaker: Unknown
en: Where is my agent failing?
zh: 我的智能体在哪里失败了？

speaker: Unknown
en: Is it capturing maybe a product surface area that I hadn't coded for?
zh: 它是不是捕捉到了某个我没有编码过的产品面？

speaker: Unknown
en: Is there a new edge case I need to code for in my agent?
zh: 是否有我需要在我的智能体里为其编码的新边缘情况？

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe I need to expose a new tool.
zh: 也许我需要暴露一个新工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: All those become possible once you have the results directly on the spans.
zh: 一旦你把结果直接放在片段上，所有这些都成为可能。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I'll just kind of flag and end with this thought.
zh: 所以我只想标记并以这个想法作结。

speaker: Unknown
en: The same loop that you're doing to improve some of these tools like coding agents, we now need to do for voice.
zh: 你为改进一些这类工具（比如编码智能体）所做的同一个循环，我们现在需要为语音来做。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the loop really follows observe, evaluate, and improve.
zh: 这个循环基本上遵循观察、评估和改进。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then from that loop, you can start to get some really, really cool continuous improvement loops within the Arise platform.
zh: 然后从这个循环出发，你可以在 Arise 平台内开始获得一些非常、非常酷的持续改进循环。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or within another platform if you choose to use it as well.
zh: 或者如果你选择使用另一个平台，也可以在其中进行。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the idea is once you observe and you have the data available to you, then you evaluate and you have the scores in line with your observations, then you can start to kick off fixes, whether they're fixes that you make or whether they're fixes that an agent is automatically making on behalf of you.
zh: 这个想法是，一旦你完成观察并拥有了可用的数据，然后你进行评估并让分数与你的观察内联，接下来你就可以开始启动修复，无论是你亲手做的修复，还是由智能体代表你自动做的修复。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then you can start to verify and validate those fixes.
zh: 然后你可以开始验证和校验那些修复。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we just released agent experiments as well in Arise.
zh: 所以我们刚刚在 Arise 中也发布了智能体实验（agent experiments）。

speaker: Unknown
en: Agent experiments, you can think of it kind of like Postman with tracing.
zh: 智能体实验，你可以把它想象成带追踪的 Postman。

speaker: Unknown
en: So imagine a world where you have audio streaming in from your users.
zh: 想象这样一个世界：你的用户的音频流进来，

speaker: Unknown
en: It's automatically traced.
zh: 它被自动追踪。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have live evaluations in the platform that are automatically scoring those interactions.
zh: 你在平台里有实时评估，自动对这些交互进行打分。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then you have SRE agents, so not an actual engineer that you hire, but an SRE agent that's looking through the traces, understanding the failure modes, hypothesizing a fix, and then actually standing up a fix for you in dev, replaying those failed traces for you against that fixed endpoint.
zh: 然后你还有 SRE 智能体，也就是说不是你雇来的真实工程师，而是一个 SRE 智能体，它在翻看追踪、理解故障模式、提出修复假设，然后实际上在 dev 环境里为你搭建起一个修复，针对那个修复后的端点为你重放那些失败的追踪。

speaker: Unknown
en: Tracing that to validate that the latency actually decreases.
zh: 对其进行追踪，以验证延迟确实降低了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you wake up in the morning.
zh: 然后你早上醒来。

speaker: Unknown
en: You look at a PR.
zh: 你看到一个 PR。

speaker: Unknown
en: The PR has a description of a problem.
zh: 这个 PR 里有一个问题的描述。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hey, I found out why the latency was high.
zh: 嘿，我发现了延迟为什么高。

speaker: Unknown
en: Turns out we were not truncating our tool results.
zh: 原来我们没有截断工具结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we were passing in way too much information to the agent.
zh: 所以我们给智能体传入了太多的信息。

speaker: Unknown
en: Context got overloaded.
zh: 上下文过载了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I introduced the truncation algorithm.
zh: 我引入了截断算法。

speaker: Unknown
en: I shipped it.
zh: 我把它上线了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I actually stood it up in dev.
zh: 我实际上在 dev 环境里把它搭建起来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I tested against the traces that failed.
zh: 我针对那些失败的追踪做了测试。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's a report card.
zh: 这是一份成绩单。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's how latency decreased.
zh: 这是延迟降低的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you wake up in the morning and all this is ready for you and you just click approve or deny on the PR.
zh: 而你早上醒来，这一切都已经为你准备好了，你只需要在 PR 上点击批准或拒绝。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is the future that I think we want to see at Arise where self-healing software and continuous improvement are realities for everyone who's building agents.
zh: 这就是我认为我们想在 Arise 看到的未来：自愈软件和持续改进成为每一个构建智能体的人的现实。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think making that possible for voice is really, really important.
zh: 我认为让这一切在语音领域成为可能是非常非常重要的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So start seeing your agents.
zh: 所以开始观察你的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Add the OpenInference instrumenter.
zh: 添加 OpenInference instrumenter。

speaker: Unknown
en: Open source, free to use, OTEL compliant.
zh: 开源，免费使用，符合 OTEL 规范。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can send it to any backend.
zh: 你可以把它发送到任何后端。

speaker: Unknown
en: So use Arise, don't use Arise, start tracing your audio.
zh: 所以用 Arise 也好，不用 Arise 也好，开始追踪你的音频。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second part of this is actually starting to do that analysis, and we would recommend Arise to do that.
zh: 第二部分实际上就是开始做那种分析，我们会推荐用 Arise 来做。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sign up for your free account.
zh: 注册你的免费账户。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll have a code up at the end of my presentation for you guys to sign up for a free year of pro.
zh: 我会在演示结束时放一个代码，供你们注册免费一年的 pro 版。

speaker: Unknown
en: But start checking time to first audio.
zh: 但要开始检查 time to first audio。

speaker: Unknown
en: Start checking your interruptions.
zh: 开始检查你的打断情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: And start evaluating how these interactions are actually going and whether they're accomplishing your use cases, whether it's a tone or latency eval.
zh: 开始评估这些交互实际上进行得如何，以及它们是否实现了你的用例，无论是语气评估还是延迟评估。

speaker: Unknown
en: Try using the Arise skills to actually create that eval.
zh: 试试用 Arise skills 来实际创建那个评估。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have some docs set up for you if you want to follow along.
zh: 如果你想跟着做，我们为你准备了一些文档。

speaker: Unknown
en: A bunch of examples and cookbooks ready and bring voice into the same rigor as the rest of your stat.
zh: 一堆示例和 cookbook 已经就绪，让语音获得与你其他 stat 同等的严谨性。

speaker: Unknown
en: You wouldn't be OK with this happening at the coding agent level.
zh: 你不会接受这种事情发生在 coding agent 层面上。

speaker: Unknown
en: You wouldn't be OK with it happening for an agent that's able to execute stocks on Robinhood.
zh: 你不会接受这种事情发生在一个能够在 Robinhood 上执行股票交易的智能体身上。

speaker: Unknown
en: You shouldn't be OK with it, though the stakes might seem a little lower for a McDonald's agent that's ordering you a cheeseburger either.
zh: 尽管对一个帮你点芝士汉堡的麦当劳智能体来说，赌注看起来可能低一些，但你也不应该接受它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I'll end with that.
zh: 所以我就以此作结。

speaker: Unknown
en: Please, please keep building.
zh: 请，请继续构建。

speaker: Unknown
en: Please connect with me also on Twitter.
zh: 也请在 Twitter 上与我联系。

speaker: Unknown
en: I still call it Twitter, not X.
zh: 我还是叫它 Twitter，不叫 X。

speaker: Unknown
en: On Twitter or LinkedIn, we'd love to kind of talk and hear about some of the use cases you guys are building towards so we can add more evals to our library and make sure this is useful for you.
zh: 在 Twitter 或 LinkedIn 上，我们很乐意聊聊，听听你们正在构建的一些用例，这样我们就可以往我们的库里添加更多评估，确保这对你们有用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you found this talk useful and you want to start investigating your voice agents,
zh: 如果你觉得这次演讲有用，并且想开始研究你的语音智能体，

speaker: Unknown
en: There is a free code up on the screen.
zh: 屏幕上有一个免费代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: It gives you a year of Arise Pro for free.
zh: 它给你免费一年的 Arise Pro。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's AIEWF2026.
zh: 代码是 AIEWF2026。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can get started and start tracing your voice agents.
zh: 你可以开始上手，开始追踪你的语音智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: So thank you very much.
zh: 非常感谢大家。

speaker: Unknown
en: My name is Fuad Ali.
zh: 我叫 Fuad Ali。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll be available for questions for a couple minutes after, but really appreciate you guys listening.
zh: 之后几分钟我可以回答问题，非常感谢大家的聆听。

speaker: Unknown
en: Cheers.
zh: 谢谢。
